sceneDescription: On a grocery checkout conveyor belt, a giant, pristine golden egg sits awkwardly between a stack of plain brown cardboard shipping boxes (some with subtle Digital Commerce 360 and Jeweller stickers) and an ordinary, battered Amazon parcel. The absurdity comes from the exaggerated size and luxury of the egg compared to the mundane, utilitarian parcels—evoking the bizarre value shifts in online commerce and luxury dividends. The scene is brightly lit, with natural daylight from above, and all objects appear touchable and real.
